messages:
Ava: Quick check — Juniper story is interview-complete. Need legal ok on the customer quote + signed consent. Proposed publish week of Apr 10. Who can own quote clearance and confirm lead routing?

Elena: They returned consent form this morning and authorized use of the quote. I've uploaded signed PDF to Drive: https://drive.redwood/juniper/consent.pdf

Sahil: Drafted the post and embedded the quote below. If legal signs off I'll lock copy.
```quote
"Redwood's latency improvements cut our inference cost by ~38% and doubled throughput during peak loads."
— Priya Raman, VP of ML, Juniper Health
```

Maya: Heads up — the quote calls out 'CompetitorX'. We usually ask to redact competitor names in customer quotes. Can we change to 'a previous vendor' or get explicit permission?

Ava: Let's anonymize for now to 'a previous vendor' and ask customer to confirm. Elena — can you ping Priya?

Elena: On it. Pinged via email just now, asked to confirm the anonymized wording and to approve the final asset by EOD tomorrow.

Jon: Also need to validate the throughput number before publishing. I'll run a quick audit of the benchmark artifacts and post the signed-off numbers here by tomorrow noon.

Kai: Creative note — can we get Juniper's brand colors? If legal needs logo use approval, we'll wait. Preparing hero options.

Sahil: Tracking & routing: campaign=juniper_cs, UTM strings ready. How should inbound leads be routed? Recommend AE Rachel + SDR queue; tagging in Intercom.

Ava: Confirming routing to Rachel and SDR-ops. @Rachel fyi.

Rachel: Ack, will set up lead routing workflow and cadence in HubSpot. Also want a short enable doc for AE talking points — Sahil can you draft.

Sahil: Yep, will draft a 1-pager with 3 talking points + benchmark bullets.

Maya: Once Elena confirms wording, I can clear legal redlines. Prefer final version by 2025-04-08 for PR embargo prep.

PublishBot: Embargo reminder scheduled — target publish 2025-04-10 09:00 UTC. Auto-post workflow will trigger 24h prior for final checks. :calendar:

Elena: Customer confirmed anonymized quote and signed the addendum. Attached timestamped approval. I'll drop final PDF in the Drive folder.

Ava: Awesome — plan:
- Jon: post audit numbers by tomorrow noon
- Maya: legal sign-off once numbers & wording finalized
- Kai: hero options by Apr 4
- Sahil: draft post + AE 1-pager
- Rachel: lead routing + HubSpot workflow

Anything else?

Jon: I'll flag if any metric changes. If all good, we can go into PR prep slot.

Maya: I'll queue legal approval today contingent on audit. :thumbsup:

PublishBot: Status: ready_for_final_check (publish pipeline, campaign=juniper_cs)

Ava: Thanks team. Will reconvene async — ping here with any blockers.
